pages.text: Like bows, arrows are built from parts — assembled at the $(l)Fletching Table$():$(br)$(li)$(l)Head$() — damage and on-hit effect$(li)$(l)Shaft$() — weight, gravity, and flight$(li)$(l)Fletching$() — accuracy and stability

Heads carry the personality: $(l)broadheads$() cause bleed, $(l)bodkin points$() punch through armor, $(l)weighted hooks$() grapple you across gaps, and $(l)trailing rope$() heads lay a climbable line.$(br2)Mix and match to build the arrow the moment calls for.
